profile_text.body:
Okta is a publicly traded identity security company, founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker OKTA. The company describes itself as putting identity at the heart of business security and growth, offering two platforms, Okta and Auth0, which provide secure access, authentication, and automation for employees, customers, and non-human identities.

On the AI side, Okta tracks a product called Okta AI, positioned within the Security and Identity AI category. It covers identity AI, risk-based authentication, privileged access, and identity threat detection. The company presents its platforms as extensible, serving workforce, customer, and non-human identity use cases.

The site's held facts show Okta carries an SEC CIK of 0001660134 and has 174 law-related entries associated with California, indicating a notable volume of legal exposure in that jurisdiction, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data.
